newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Russia to ease gas restrictions on Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: Russia to ease gas restrictions on Bosnia.

text.p: A Russian gas company will ease restrictions on supplies to Bosnia after reaching an agreement with Bosnian Serbs on debt repayments, an international spokesman told a news conference on Friday.
Bosnian Serbs promised to pay monthly in future for supplies from Gasexport monthly and to pay off debts for past supplies.
Gasexport reduced its gas deliveries to Bosnia in February when the country's debt reached $12.4 million, forcing the authorities to introduce rationing.
Colum Murphy, a spokesman for the international High Representative in Sarajevo said Gasexport was being urged to fully restore supplies to their previous level.
"If this is achieved we would return to gas supply on a 24- hour basis," Murphy said.
